meta.name: nemo-evaluator-sdk
meta.description: Evaluates LLMs across 100+ benchmarks from 18+ harnesses (MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K, safety, VLM) with multi-backend execution. Use when needing scalable evaluation on local Docker, Slurm HPC, or cloud platforms. NVIDIA's enterprise-grade platform with container-first architecture for reproducible benchmarking.

copy.tagline: 用企业级平台在多种环境评测大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用标准基准评测LLM并复现结果
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate LLMs across 100+ benchmarks on any infrastructure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate LLMs with reproducible benchmarks across local, HPC, or cloud

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 NeMo Evaluator SDK 来评测大语言模型。它会根据你指定的配置，在本地 Docker、Slurm HPC 集群或云端运行 100 多个基准测试（如 MMLU、GSM8K、HumanEval），并输出评测结果。
howto.when: 当你需要评测一个模型在多个标准基准上的表现，或者需要在不同后端（本地、Slurm、云）上运行评测时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 MMLU 和 GSM8K 评测一下 Llama 3.1 8B 模型。
say.note: Claude 会生成配置文件并运行评测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the NeMo Evaluator SDK to evaluate LLMs. It runs 100+ benchmarks (e.g., MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval) on local Docker, Slurm HPC, or cloud, and outputs results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to evaluate a model on standard benchmarks or run evaluations across different backends (local, Slurm, cloud).

say_en.text: Evaluate Llama 3.1 8B on MMLU and GSM8K.
say_en.note: Claude will generate config and run evaluation.

say_en.text: Run IFEval and HumanEval on my custom model via Slurm.
say_en.note: Claude will configure Slurm and submit job.

say_en.text: Compare Llama 3.1 8B vs Mistral 7B on MMLU.
say_en.note: Claude will run two evaluations and export results.
